meta.title: KabuK Platform — Travel Technology Infrastructure
meta.description: Explore KabuK Platform, the technology foundation for travel connectivity, pricing, booking, reservations, financial workflows, and operations.

hero.title: The technology foundation for connected travel.
hero.lead: KabuK Platform brings pricing, booking, reservations, financial workflows, content, and partner operations together in a shared technology foundation—designed to help travel businesses connect systems and manage complexity.

value.title: Less fragmentation. More connected operations.
value.lead: Travel businesses rely on systems that must coordinate inventory, pricing, reservations, payments, and partner relationships. KabuK Platform is designed to connect these workflows through consistent services and operational controls.

pillars.title: Connected by design
pillars.body: Establish common integration patterns across suppliers, channels, and operational systems.

pillars.title: Consistent booking workflows
pillars.body: Coordinate reservation states, changes, cancellations, and downstream operational events.

pillars.title: Commercial and financial clarity
pillars.body: Support pricing rules, invoicing, reconciliation, and settlement-related workflows.

pillars.title: Built for operations
pillars.body: Give teams the visibility and controls needed to manage partner and transaction lifecycles.

capabilities.title: Core services that work together.
capabilities.lead: KabuK Platform organizes foundational travel technology into connected service domains. Specific integrations and availability depend on the use case and implementation scope.

audiences.title: Infrastructure for travel businesses and destinations.
audiences.lead: Different business models need different things from the same foundation. Each engagement starts with your requirements.

relationship.eyebrow: Part of the KabuK product family
relationship.title: The foundation behind KabuK Exchange.
relationship.body: KabuK Platform provides the underlying technology services for pricing, booking, reservations, content, financial workflows, and operations. KabuK Exchange is the separate distribution product that connects travel supply with demand partners using that foundation.

transparency.title: How we describe our capabilities
transparency.body: We label each service area by maturity—core service, in development, or planned—and confirm scope with every partner. Nothing on this site is a service-level commitment or a public API.

cta.title: Tell us what you're building.
cta.body: Share your requirements and our team can discuss possible integration or collaboration paths.

hotels.title: Connect your properties to the systems behind distribution.
hotels.body: KabuK Platform is designed to support accommodation connectivity, reservation workflows, pricing controls, and the operational processes needed to participate in connected travel commerce. Distribution through KabuK Exchange is a separate product pathway.
topics: Connectivity through existing PMS or channel manager

destinations.title: Build a more connected destination ecosystem.
destinations.body: Explore how common technology services could support regional accommodation connectivity, inventory coordination, and access to distribution channels. Solutions should be scoped to the needs of each destination and participating businesses.

wholesalers.title: Simplify the systems behind inventory distribution.
wholesalers.body: Connect content, pricing, booking, and financial workflows through a consistent infrastructure foundation. Commercial distribution opportunities are handled through KabuK Exchange where applicable.

travel.title: Build on travel-specific infrastructure.
travel.body: Explore technology services designed around booking lifecycles, commercial rules, partner operations, and integrations—without assuming that every business needs to build each foundation component independently.

meta.title: Solutions for Travel Businesses — KabuK Platform
meta.description: Technology infrastructure for hotels, destinations, wholesalers, suppliers, and travel businesses.

hero.title: One foundation, shaped to different travel business models.
hero.lead: Hotels, destinations, suppliers, and travel companies coordinate the same core workflows in different ways. We scope each engagement to the business—not the other way around.

pathway.title: How an engagement typically starts.
pathway.lead: An indicative sequence. The actual path depends on your systems, scope, and commercial model.

steps.title: Share your requirements
steps.body: Tell us about your business, systems, and the workflows you want to connect.

steps.title: Assess fit and scope
steps.body: We review which Platform services are relevant and what is available for your use case.

steps.title: Plan the integration
steps.body: Agree on systems, data, responsibilities, and the commercial framework.

steps.title: Implement in stages
steps.body: Start with a defined scope and extend once the foundation is working for you.

exchangeNote.title: Looking for distribution?
exchangeNote.body: If your goal is to sell inventory to B2B demand partners, KabuK Exchange is the distribution product. KabuK Platform provides the technology underneath it.

meta.title: Platform Capabilities — KabuK Platform
meta.description: Learn about pricing, booking, reservations, content, financial workflows, identity, and operational services in KabuK Platform.

hero.title: Core services that work together.
hero.lead: KabuK Platform organizes foundational travel technology into connected service domains. Specific integrations and availability depend on the use case and implementation scope.

architecture.title: Coordinated services, one foundation.
architecture.lead: Each domain has a clear responsibility. Together they share integration patterns, data, permissions, and operational visibility.

legend.title: Capability status
legend.core: A foundation service area within KabuK Platform. Scope is confirmed for each engagement.
legend.development: Actively being built. Timing and scope are not yet committed.
legend.planned: On the roadmap. Not available today.

pricing.body: Configure pricing logic, availability workflows, and distribution-related commercial rules.
pricing.note: Pricing is rule-based. Automated or machine-learning price optimization is not part of the current scope.

booking.body: Coordinate booking transactions and the reservation lifecycle across connected systems.
booking.note: Support for specific change, cancellation, and refund flows depends on each supplier and integration.

content.body: Organize accommodation content and normalize supplier, property, and room information.
content.note: Mapping quality depends on source data. Mappings are reviewed as part of operations.

billing.body: Support invoicing, reconciliation, accounts payable and receivable, and settlement workflows.
billing.note: KabuK Platform supports financial workflows. It is not a licensed payment processor or escrow service.

identity.body: Manage partner access and operational administration through defined permissions and tools.
identity.note: Security practices and any certifications are shared during engagement, not claimed here.

analytics.body: Build operational visibility and explore AI-assisted workflows for repetitive processes.
analytics.note: AI-assisted workflows, including KAOS, are planned and in development. They are not generally available.

connectivity.title: Common integration patterns.
connectivity.body: KabuK Platform is designed to connect supplier, channel, and operational systems through consistent patterns rather than one-off integrations. PMS, CRS, and channel managers act as connectivity providers; which systems can be connected is confirmed during scoping.

operations.title: Built to be operated, not just integrated.
operations.body: Travel transactions continue long after a booking is made. Platform services are designed with operational controls so teams can see state, act on exceptions, and keep records consistent.
points: Visibility of transaction and partner lifecycles
Controls for exceptions and manual intervention
Consistent records across pricing, booking, and finance

technology.disclaimer: This page describes service areas and design intent. It is not a service-level agreement, a public API specification, or a commitment that any capability is available as a standalone product.

meta.title: Why KabuK Platform
meta.description: A connected technology foundation designed to reduce fragmentation across travel operations.

hero.title: Less fragmentation. More connected operations.
hero.lead: Travel businesses rely on systems that must coordinate inventory, pricing, reservations, payments, and partner relationships. KabuK Platform is designed to connect these workflows through consistent services and operational controls.

problem.title: Every new connection adds complexity.
problem.lead: When each system integrates separately with each partner, rules, states, and records drift apart. A shared foundation keeps them consistent.

why.pillarsTitle: What a shared foundation is designed to provide

pillarsDetail.title: Connected by design
pillarsDetail.body: Establish common integration patterns across suppliers, channels, and operational systems.
pillarsDetail.detail: New partners follow known structures for content, availability, and reservation events, instead of a new custom model each time.

pillarsDetail.title: Consistent booking workflows
pillarsDetail.body: Coordinate reservation states, changes, cancellations, and downstream operational events.
pillarsDetail.detail: One reservation lifecycle means operations, finance, and partners refer to the same state.

pillarsDetail.title: Commercial and financial clarity
pillarsDetail.body: Support pricing rules, invoicing, reconciliation, and settlement-related workflows.
pillarsDetail.detail: Commercial rules and financial records are connected, which makes differences easier to trace.

pillarsDetail.title: Built for operations
pillarsDetail.body: Give teams the visibility and controls needed to manage partner and transaction lifecycles.
pillarsDetail.detail: Exceptions are visible and actionable, rather than discovered after the fact.

items.title: Travel-specific
items.body: Services are shaped around booking lifecycles, commercial rules, and partner operations.

items.title: Modular boundaries
items.body: Service domains have clear responsibilities, so they can evolve as partner needs change.

items.title: Honest about maturity
items.body: We distinguish core services, work in development, and planned capabilities—and confirm scope with every partner.

notList.title: What KabuK Platform is not
items: Not an online travel agency or consumer booking brand
notList.body: Distribution is handled by KabuK Exchange, a separate product built on this foundation.
